subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A school built a rain garden near the parking lot.”?
options: A student said the plants looked ordinary.
Plants, soil, and stones were working together.
Later, new gardens appeared with stones, local plants, and shaded soil.
The city restored one section with plants, stones, and gentle slopes.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A student said the plants looked ordinary.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Plants, soil, and stones were working together.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Later, new gardens appeared with stones, local plants, and shaded soil.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The city restored one section with plants, stones, and gentle slopes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Plants, soil, and stones were working together.」，答案為「Plants, soil, and stones were working together.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Plants, soil, and stones were working together.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
